gap: Duration of the tandem skydive experience not stated
blurb: Guests take a scenic flight to 10,000 ft above ground, then exit the plane attached to an instructor for a tandem skydive. Freefall lasts approximately until 5,000 ft, where the parachute opens for a slow descent. The experience includes views of Mt. Currie, Pemberton, and Whistler.
extraNote: Weather evaluation on day of jump; few clouds and light winds ideal · No alcohol or drugs allowed; will not be allowed to board if present · Pemberton Airport
